notes: Questions with answerable=false should be refused, not guessed. Section names match the exact heading text in the document.

questions.question: How much is the monthly rent?
questions.expected_answer: $1,800 per month.

questions.question: When is the rent due each month?
questions.expected_answer: On or before the 1st day of each month, in advance.

questions.question: How much is the security deposit?
questions.expected_answer: $2,700, paid on or before the start of the Term.

questions.question: How soon after moving out should I get my deposit back?
questions.expected_answer: Within 30 days after moving out and returning the keys, less itemized deductions.

questions.question: How long is the lease term?
questions.expected_answer: January 1, 2026 to December 31, 2026.

questions.question: What happens when the lease term ends and nobody gives notice?
questions.expected_answer: It continues on a month-to-month basis.

questions.question: What is the late fee if I pay rent late?
questions.expected_answer: $75 if rent is not received by the 5th day of the month.

questions.question: I still haven't paid rent after 10 days. What happens now?
questions.expected_answer: An additional fee of $10 per day applies until the rent is paid in full.

questions.question: Who pays for water and trash collection?
questions.expected_answer: The Landlord pays for water, sewer, and trash collection.

questions.question: Do I have to set up the electricity account myself?
questions.expected_answer: Yes. The Tenant pays for electricity, gas, internet, and cable, and must place those accounts in the Tenant's name before move-in.

questions.question: Can I get a dog?
questions.expected_answer: Only with the Landlord's prior written consent. If approved, a one-time $300 pet deposit and $25 monthly pet fee apply. Service animals are not considered pets and no fee applies.

questions.question: Can I rent out the apartment to someone else?
questions.expected_answer: No. The Tenant may not sublet or assign the Lease without the Landlord's written consent.

questions.question: Can I operate a small business from the apartment?
questions.expected_answer: No. No business may be operated from the Premises.

questions.question: The heating stopped working. Who is responsible for fixing it?
questions.expected_answer: The Landlord is responsible for repairs to plumbing, heating, electrical systems, and provided appliances, except where the damage was caused by the Tenant or the Tenant's guests.

questions.question: Is smoking allowed in the apartment?
questions.expected_answer: No. Smoking, including vaping, is prohibited inside the Premises and in all enclosed common areas.

questions.question: Can my landlord walk in without telling me?
questions.expected_answer: Not normally. The Landlord must give at least 24 hours' notice, except in an emergency.

questions.question: Can my friend stay with me for a month?
questions.expected_answer: No. A guest may stay for no more than 14 consecutive days without the Landlord's written approval.

questions.question: Am I required to have renter's insurance?
questions.expected_answer: Yes. The Tenant must carry renter's insurance with at least $100,000 of liability coverage and provide proof on request.

questions.question: How much notice do I need to give to end the lease early, and what does it cost?
questions.expected_answer: At least 60 days' written notice plus an early termination fee equal to two months' rent ($3,600). The Tenant remains responsible for rent until the termination date.

questions.question: Can I paint the walls in the apartment?
questions.expected_answer: The lease does not address painting or alterations.

questions.question: Who is responsible for pest control or extermination?
questions.expected_answer: The lease does not address pest control.

questions.question: Is there a move-in inspection or condition report?
questions.expected_answer: The lease does not mention a move-in inspection or condition report.
